summary: STRATS Trust for Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities, Series 2005-1 filed an 8-K reporting a routine distribution to certificate holders on June 15, 2026, detailed in Exhibit 99.1. The trust is a special-purpose vehicle holding junior subordinated debentures issued by Goldman Sachs. The filing notes no other reportable transactions or events. This is a standard periodic distribution update with no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activism, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The form 8-K is a routine current report under Items 8.01 and 9.01.
